values.value: SELECT Id, Status__c, LabTestRequisitionNumber__c, SystemType__c, SpecimenSource__c, SamplerName__c, HealthAuthority__c, DWOEHOName__c, BoilAdvisory__c, Site_Descriptor__c, Site_Number__c, Site_Treatment__c, Drinking_Water_Component_Name__r.Name, Drinking_Water_Component_Name__r.Address, FacilityName__r.Name, ToLaboratory__c, FacilityName__r.Physical_Address__c FROM LabTestRequisition__c WHERE RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PHOCSWaterLabTestRequisition' AND FacilityName__c != NULL AND ToLaboratory__c = 'BCCDC' AND TestCategory__c = 'Bacteriological' AND Status__c = 'Requested' AND SubmittedDateTime__c = NULL ORDER BY LastModifiedDate ASC LIMIT 2000
